entry.description: make the release verification scripts fail closed. `verify-release.ps1` reported a SHA-512 mismatch with `-ErrorAction Continue` and never checked the exit code of `gpg`, so it extracted the archive and exited 0 for a tampered artifact or a broken signature. Both scripts looped over whichever `.asc` files were present, so deleting them left nothing to verify and the scripts succeeded. The checks are now driven from the artifacts, each of which must have a `.sha512` and a `.asc`, and the keys are imported into a key ring of their own so that a signature from any other key this machine trusts is no longer accepted (audit 1231d72-f009, 1231d72-f010)
